name: CI/CD Pipeline Design, Hardening & Reproducibility
purpose: Design, implement, and audit CI/CD pipelines so every validation is reproducible from a clean checkout, with hermetic dependencies, safe caching, fail-fast contract gates, and secret-free logs.
inputs: CI platform and runner fleet definition (GitHub Actions or GitLab CI)
Workflow definitions (.github/workflows/*.yaml or .gitlab-ci.yml) at the pinned commit
Merge-gate policy: required checks, branch protection, environment approvers
Secret inventory: names, owning environments, and rotation dates
outputs: Versioned workflow files with pinned actions, staged gates, and cache keys
Merge-gate configuration with required checks and approvers
Reproducibility report with clean-run logs, timings, and flake rate
stop_conditions: Full pipeline green on two consecutive clean-cache runs from a fresh checkout
Flake rate below 2 percent across the last 50 runs on the protected branch
All required checks wired to branch protection with approvers assigned
